item.title: ProSweets Cologne to Rebrand as ISM Manufacturing
item.description: With the rebranding to ISM Manufacturing, the event will continue to cover four central themes: Packaging Materials, Packaging Technology, Production Technology and Operating Equipment & Auxiliary Devices.

item.title: Harpak-ULMA Positions Mondini Trave Sinfonia Tray-Sealing Platform for Ground Meat
item.description: Although the Sinfonia system was introduced in 2023, this marks its first application for grind-line environments, where tray control, contamination and mechanical indexing have long limited achievable speeds.

item.title: SymphonyAI Debuts 8 Apps for Food and Beverage Manufacturing
item.description: These apps are engineered around high-speed lines, thermal variability, CIP/SIP complexity, micro-stoppages, drift conditions and robotics.

item.title: Connected Plants Lead to Advanced Packaging Line Optimization
item.description: Investments in automation and additional tools for data analytics keep coming to packaging lines as plants become more connected. Machine learning and digital twin technology are increasing throughput and driving innovation for large and small brands.

item.title: M2 Ingredients Opens Center of Innovation
item.description: The M2 Center of Innovation brings together functional mushroom R&D teams and a purpose-built facility to support brands developing foods, beverages and supplements across formats.

item.title: The Marzetti Company to Acquire Bachan’s Japanese Barbecue Sauce Brand
item.description: Marzetti says the transaction reinforces its expanding position in the sauce category and is expected to provide additional growth opportunities through its retail and foodservice distribution network.

item.title: Cultivated Beef Producer Omeat Rebrands as Evergreen Select
item.description: Evergreen says its new identity formalizes a strategy that shifts cultivated meat from a consumer curiosity to a dependable infrastructure solution that strengthens the existing beef supply chain.

item.title: InnovAsian to Open Frozen Food Plant in Arkansas
item.description: InnovAsian’s parent company Nichirei will make a capital contribution of approximately $105 million to initiate the project.

item.title: Post Consumer Brands Names Greg Pearson as President and CEO
item.description: Pearson brings to Post 25 years of experience in the consumer packaged goods industry.

item.title: Hummus Maker Little Sesame Opens Factory in Maryland
item.description: The new factory will increase Little Sesame's production capacity, moving from an annual output of 4 million pounds to a projected 20 million pounds at full capacity.
